thread:
Maria G.: quick UI/docs mismatch spotted in the Model Serve panel — pinging product/design/engineers.

Maria G.: In the console we show 'Model display name' but docs refer to `model_id` and 'Model name'. Customers keep asking which to use in API calls.

Alex P.: I saw this in support tickets too. We should pick one canonical term. leaning toward `Model ID` (matches API) but we can show friendly label in UI.

Jordan L.: Agree on canonicalizing. UX note: if we keep "Model display name" visually, add a muted helper text: "API name: `model_id`" so users can find cross-links. Also accessibility check: helper text must be programmatically associated with the input (aria-describedby).

Samir K.: Implementation heads-up: adding helper text and aria link is quick. Changing DB field/prop names is not. If we flip the UI label to 'Model ID' that'll ripple to a few components. I'd prefer helper text + docs aliases first.

Maria G.: Proposal: 1) Update in-product helper copy to show canonical API term and example, 2) Add a small inline cross-link to docs for 'model identifiers', 3) Docs add a short blurb mapping UI labels -> API names. Thoughts?

Alex P.: +1 for that incremental route. I'll draft the helper copy and add the link target. Could be: "API name (used in CLI/API): `model_id` — see docs" with link icon.

Jordan L.: Copy suggestion: "Model display name — a friendly name you set in the console. API identifier: `model_id` (used in requests)." Keep it 1 line. For keyboard users make the docs link focusable and text should be descriptive: "Learn more about model identifiers (opens documentation)".

Samir K.: For the link format, please use our internal doc deep link pattern: `/docs/console/models#identifiers`. If the team wants a redirect alias in the docs, that saves future churn if headings move. Docs team: could you add a short anchor?

docs-bot: New docs PR created by @alexp: https://gh.internal/redwood/docs/pull/421 — adds "Model identifiers" anchor and a short mapping table.

Alex P.: PR has the helper copy + cross-link markup for the panel, patch attached in the PR description.

Maria G.: Accessibility TODOs: Jordan will add aria-describedby to the input. Samir, please ensure the link has visible focus and an accessible name. Alex, coordinate with docs-bot PR for anchor name.

Jordan L.: I'll run a quick keyboard/nav pass and post results. Also flagging contrast on the muted helper text — looks borderline at 14px.

Samir K.: Noted. I can up the contrast and ensure focus outline is visible. Time estimate: helper text + link + aria changes = ~2 dev-hours + review.

Maria G.: Plan: ship helper text + docs link this week, docs team will merge anchor PR, we evaluate if a full label rename is needed after support volume meter. Owners: Alex (copy + docs PR), Jordan (a11y check), Samir (implementation). I'll post a short follow-up when PRs land.

Alex P.: thanks — will update PR and add a test to assert the anchor exists.

Jordan L.: :thumbsup: I'll do the a11y QA once the patch is on staging.

Samir K.: posting the minimal CSS tweak here for focus state:

```
.panel-helper a:focus { outline: 3px solid #0366d6; outline-offset: 2px; }
```

Maria G.: perfect, thanks. Closing the loop: we'll avoid renaming UI labels this sprint unless support still spikes. If anyone sees edge cases (e.g., Dedicated vs Reserved terminology) add them in replies and we'll triage.

Alex P.: small follow-up: should we also add an alias in the CLI help? e.g., show both `--model-id` and `--model-name`?

Samir K.: good call; CLI is cheap to update. add to the docs PR and I'll coordinate a tiny CLI patch.

Maria G.: awesome — thanks team.
